content.short: Megaton Finance is a TON-based DeFi exchange for accessing digital assets, game tokens, and liquidity.
content.description: Megaton Finance is positioned as a decentralized exchange in the TON ecosystem. It gives users access to digital assets and game tokens, making it useful for swaps and liquidity around TON-native markets and gaming-related assets. Gain access to exclusive digital assets, game tokens. Megaton Finance belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface. Megaton Finance is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
